description:
Create a customer

Creates a customer (201): a group of keys with its own monthly limit, balance record and usage. With an externalRef that already exists, returns that one with 200 instead, so a signup webhook can be retried safely. Its usage is debited directly from your balance at our price, so its keys work without any credit. With billingMode limit, or a spendLimitUsd sent alone, spendLimitUsd caps its monthly usage (PATCH sets it for any customer). initialCreditUsd only records a payment for your books. Amounts are at our price. At most 10,000 customers per account: past it, 409 limit_reached.

externalRef.description: Your own id. Creating a customer with an externalRef that already exists returns that one (200) instead of a new one, so a signup webhook can be retried safely.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A unique string so that repeating this call never creates twice.

initialCreditUsd.description: billingMode prepaid only: a payment to record as the opening balanceUsd. Not needed for its keys to work. 0, or from 0.00000001 to less than 1,000,000.

spendLimitUsd.description: billingMode limit only: monthly spending cap at our price. PATCH sets it for any customer.
